text:
Ana W.: Running the Web quickstart (React starter) against a freshly-provisioned SSO org. App boots, but the first API call returns 403 billing_required. Console billing page says 'Billing unavailable for your org' and there is no place to add a card. Anyone run into this with SSO-created orgs?
Jon (devex): can you paste the fetch you made and the response body?
Ana W.: from devtools network:
```http
POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer sk-test-abc
Body: {"model":"rw-mini-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}
```
response:
```json
{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"Workspace 4242: billing disabled for this organization."}}
```
Jon (devex): that specific message usually means the org was auto-mapped to a restricted plan during provisioning (partner or enterprise mapping). SCIM flows sometimes set metadata that triggers that.
Priya (docs): this is slightly different from the usual "provisioned vs needs_billing" case — the UI intentionally hides the add-card CTA for restricted plans. We should add a short troubleshooting note in the Web quickstart telling devs what text to look for and who to contact.
Marco (billing): confirmed: org 4242 shows plan=partner_restricted, payment_method=null. Policy prevents self-serve add-card. For internal testing we can flip the plan to self_serve_temp or temporarily enable billing via support console.
Ana W.: is there a safe URL my admin can try? The console link in the error just goes to billing page with the 'unavailable' card.
Jon (devex): internal workaround for admins: /orgs/4242/billing/force_add_card?internal=true will surface the add-card form. Not public, but works for infra/support/admins. Long-term we should show a clearer message in the app explaining "enterprise/partner mapping" and link to support.
ops-bot: Created ticket DX-6011: "Quickstart: surface clearer guidance for partner/enterprise-mapped orgs blocking self-serve billing" assigned to devex + billing-provisioning.
Priya (docs): action items: 1) add a one-liner in Web quickstart README: "If you see 'billing disabled for this organization', contact infra or support; internal admins can use a force-add route." 2) add an FAQ entry explaining partner_restricted vs provisioned. 3) add analytics to capture 403::partner_restricted from web-runner.
Marco (billing): also adding a small change in the billing UI: when plan=partner_restricted show a tooltip that explains why add-card is hidden and provide the support contact link.
Ana W.: admin used the force_add link and was able to add a card; after that the quickstart fetch returned 200. Please drop the quickstart note and ping me.
Jon (devex): will open a docs PR and link DX-6011. Thanks for the clear repro and the network snippet, that helped. Closing once docs + UI tooltip land. :rocket:
